\section{Results}
Participants were faster with the new technique ($F(1, 23) = 4.6$, $p = .03$, $p < .001$),
as \autoref{fig:time} and \autoref{tab:errors} show.

      \addplot+[fill=OkabeItoBlue!50!white] coordinates {(1,2)};
    \end{axis}
  \end{tikzpicture}
  \caption{Selection time by technique.}
  \label{fig:time}
\end{figure}
